author: Connie M.
text: Mr. Robert Parker and Sons last week did extensive work on my Greywater Diversion Device (GDD = 'wash box') and am beyond impressed with the repair that was required and the landscape measures following. I can't imagine any more gracious individuals than these three professional men, the cost and assurance of the job well done was more than a person could hope for. Thank you again Mr. Parker. PLEASE consider adding Journeyman or Master Plumber(s) to your service. With your exceptional business standards it would be a win for everyone.

author: Johanna Faustine
text: Parker's Septic service has been absolutely phenomenal with not only timeliness though truly being experts in their field. Robert was very knowledgeable and explained in detail what repairs were needed. Him and his team acted quickly and had excellent communication throughout the entire process. Thank you Robert! I look forward to working with you in the future!

author: Sendy Rallings
text: This is by far the best septic tank service we have had since moving to the area.  The last time our tank was serviced, the technician did not perform all the steps Robert did or even clean the filter.  Since this is our first time having a septic tank, we did not know the last service was not done properly.  As a result, we ended up with a clogged filter over the weekend.  Robert tried to help by troubleshooting over the phone.  But, ended up coming out even though he was not feeling his best.  We are very appreciative of the time Robert took to explain the maintenance of the system and to show us what was causing  the problem.  We highly recommend this company and will be using them for any septic system concerns.

author: Jenna Burch
text: I’m not one to typically leave reviews, but wow! Parker’s was absolutely phenomenal! Very kind, knowledgeable, and honest. These kinds of issues can be scary and intimidating (and costly..), but I was immediately put at ease and knew we were in good hands. I am blown away. Highly recommend - would give more than 5 stars if possible!

author: Cheryl Arrington
text: Absolute professional,  quality work, a man who honors his word. 5 star service, reliability, and extremely knowledgeable.  Great customer service, and superior communication with customer, permit offices, and utility companies to completion of job.
